sources.title: Brand claims policy (fictional brand)
sources.note: Brand policy for the demo. Not a regulation.

SG.source_ref: Brand claims policy, claims not approved
SG.title: Comparative or superlative claims
SG.description: Brand policy forbids comparative or superlative claims such as 'the best on the market'.

SG.source_ref: Brand claims policy, claims not approved
SG.title: Absolute safety claims
SG.description: Brand policy forbids 'completely safe for everyone' and similar absolute safety claims.

SG.source_ref: Brand claims policy, claims not approved
SG.title: Compared to a medicine or prescription product
SG.description: Brand policy forbids saying the product works like a medicine or prescription product.

SG.source_ref: Brand claims policy, claims not approved
SG.title: Whitening or permanent colour change
SG.description: Brand policy forbids whitening, skin-lightening or fairer-skin claims (bleaching the skin, removing or fading melanin or pigment) and claims of permanently changing skin colour.

MY.title: Unapproved superlatives
MY.description: MEDIUM unchanged; law permits substantiated superlatives, brand remains stricter.

MY.title: Medicine comparison
MY.description: MEDIUM unchanged for analogy; actual medicinal efficacy also triggers disease HIGH.

MY.title: Unapproved whitening
MY.description: same brand ban; not a blanket Malaysian whitening prohibition.
